Summary: The `WelcomeStaffAdmin` contains ASP.NET web controls and JavaScript logic to manage staff admin welcome pages and their interactions. It features setup scripts and validation controls.
Fields: valEndDate, txtEndDate, btnEndDateCalendar, CalendarExtender2, RegularExpressionValidator2, cvrEndDateAfter, chkShowWithdrawn, cmdRefreshView, lblErrorList, pnlWarning, etc.
Workflows: Form validation and data refresh operations
Validations: Date validation through RegularExpressionValidator and CustomValidator
Conditions: Validations are performed based on input dates
System Behavior: UI behavior for refreshing and displaying error/warning panels
